localPolicy.displayRemoval: Bonus applies only while displayed; remove pauses it, redisplay restores it. Original removal permanence unknown.
localPolicy.powerComposition: Add flat bonus before existing final percent multiplier; reconstructed ordering.

supersededBy: lib/fishing-species.json (86 species, its own deferred/limits keys) plus fishing-draw-data.json and fishing-combination-data.json. This file is the policy-1 record and nothing in lib/, app/ or tests/ imports it; keep it only as the provenance of the first three species.
unimplementedMethod: Re-derived against lib/fishing.mjs and the live fishing tables, not copied forward. Five entries were removed because the code now implements them: catch probabilities (castOdds/drawFish roll FishLevel rarity weights per ground), other grounds (FISHING_GROUNDS/groundLevel gate casts by fishing level), fishing level curves (FISHING_LEVELS/fishingLevel), combinations (FISH_COMBINATIONS/activateFishCombination), and crowns (claimCrownKohaku/crownKohaku). Absence of the two remaining entries was checked with a positive control: grepping lib/ and app/ for 'combination' returns five files, for 'antique' it returns only this file and two unrelated story tables, and for any length field it returns only this line. | 2026-09-15: re-derived again against Fish.json -> SkillBase.json. Length ranges were recovered in full (four bands per species on constant 5000/2500/1500/1000 weights, hundredths of a centimetre) and now ship: lib/fishing-apk-data.json, rollLength/lengthRecords. All 86 crown effects were recovered too and are stored on every species record, but are NOT activated by the length roll: adding all 86 crown skills on top of the normal ones moves the Fellow Power ceiling by +984,000 flat, +197 Aptitude and +355 percentage points, far past the ~20% the balance brief allows. The length-reward PAYOUT is genuinely absent: "longReward" appears only in Fish.json (positive control: the same sweep finds Reward_BaseLottery_1 in split_reward/reward.json).
unimplemented: length REWARDS (the three longRewardTarget milestones per species pay something the config does not name)
crown effects: recovered for all 86 species and stored, but not granted by the gold length band (power-ceiling reason above)
